purpose: Windows regression for 0.5.0: the agent desktop host became an ordinary window (not kept on top by default, minimizable, close minimizes to the taskbar, Keep on top / Clean view / Stop), and the host sets RemoteDesktop_SuppressWhenMinimized=2 so a minimized view keeps the child rendering.
environment: Clean Windows 11 26H2 VM checkpoint, 1920x1080 at 100% scale, real UAC, one re-sign-in by reboot; parent input from the Hyper-V synthetic keyboard and mouse where noted

packageVerifier.agentDesktopPreparation: Child sessions disabled: automatic preparation refused without elevation.

darkTests.1-parent-typing: Hyper-V keyboard typed 20/20 chunks into a parent fixture while the agent completed 6/6 child rounds; parent foreground unchanged, no cross-talk.
darkTests.warp: Pointer parked over the view: 3/3 child rounds; moved away: 2/2; parent cursor log shows only the two positions the test set.
darkTests.H-hover: Hovering over the view without clicking and moving outside: all child rounds succeeded; parent foreground unchanged.
darkTests.A-escape: Real click into the view, then physical Escape: every later call USER_STOPPED, child session logged off after tool stop, no reconnect.
darkTests.L-locked: Parent locked: child stayed, status parentLocked true, indexed text-box click UNSUPPORTED_ACTION in about 0.17 s (0.4.1: 2.2 s), screenshot 4480 bytes; after a real unlock the same child continued with no replay.
darkTests.B-close-then-stop: Real Hyper-V click on the title-bar close button (located by WM_NCHITTEST = HTCLOSE): host minimized, child session kept running, 2/2 child rounds and a child screenshot succeeded while minimized; a real click on the taskbar button restored it; a real click on Stop logged the child off at once, every later call returned USER_STOPPED and nothing reconnected within 20 s.

notTested: saved choices applied on the next start

windowControls.method: Real Hyper-V synthetic mouse clicks on the host's own controls (positions from UIA, caption buttons from WM_NCHITTEST); leaving clean view through the title-bar menu with a real right-click, Up and Enter.
windowControls.note: A first run of this script reported child-works-maximized as failed because of a PowerShell expression error in the script; its raw data showed 2/2 rounds succeeding. The rerun with the fixed expression passed every item.
